environment.description: Same container on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rate-based rule at priority 0 limiting to 2000 req/5min per IP, and (2) the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 with all default actions. Additionally, a custom rule at priority 2 uses a regex pattern set matching body/query inspection with the SizeConstraint on query string limited to 256 bytes via a separate custom rule at priority 3 with action BLOCK.
